text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hiyah, hiyah, hiyyaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ that feels great!
Even if the sand feels a teeny bit gritty on my feet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nope, I'm still good~! I'm totally on a roll right now!
Must be 'cause the ocean's right next to us. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, plus the summer festival is tonight! Gotta get all my training done beforehand! Chop-chop-chop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp with Matikanetannhauser was going smoothly.
We balanced hard training with enjoying the summer in moderation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Eating shaved ice at the beach hut, building sandcastles on the shore—tonight's festival was just another one of those perks.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Worked up a great sweat! I wanna just dive right into the ocean~ but that'll have to wait! Off for one more run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After training wrapped up, I parted ways with Matikanetannhauser and returned to the lodge. There was still plenty of time before the festival started.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Luckily, the lodge lobby was completely empty.
With nothing pressing on my schedule, I decided to catch some sleep on the sofa.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Puh-haaah~ What a great splash!
The ocean really is the best♪ It's pretty, and it feels so good~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, maybe a little more swim—wait, no!
I gotta get ready for the festival! Yikes, yikes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, change of clothes: complete! Belongings... probably all set! And Trainer is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Hm-mm? Wait, are they asleep?
Huh, what's up? Just an afternoon nap?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *Gasp.* Or did they crash from exhaustion...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (I mean, makes sense. They supervise my training every day, help me look for hermit crabs...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (Could I have been pushing them too hard without even realizing...?)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (All right, then I gotta get them full of energy! First things first—!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (...Wait, what should I do? How does it usually work again? How do I always get energized?)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (Ah! Come to think of it—)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Satisfied, satisfied, super satisfied~! Mun-fu-fu~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man~ I'm so glad everyone is my good friend!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Machi-nee! What're we playin' today? Cops and robbers? High-ground tag?
I got way faster, so I'm down for whatever!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see~~... Let's play high-ground tag today!
Here we go! Pappa-ka, tatta-ka, rock-paper-scissors, shoot!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Auntie
text_block_list.text: You'll do great! If anyone can do it, it's you, Machi-chan. Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Uncle
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you've worked hard to get here.
I'm sure you'll pull something good! Give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... thank you so much!
I'll give it everything I've got! One, two, go--!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Right...! I've always gotten energized thanks to everyone else!
Then maybe the same method will work to cheer up Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I only meant to take a short nap, but I must have slept for quite a while.
As I dragged my heavy body upright and opened my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was greeted by a veritable altar of assorted goods piled high on the table.
Whole roasted carrots, yakisoba pan, cheering uchiwa fans...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah! Good morniiing, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This? These are sources of pure energy I gathered from everyone!
To help you get all energized!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well... you fell asleep, right, Trainer?
Seeing that got me worried. I wanted you to cheer right up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So, I figured I'd do the same things everyone always does for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: See, remember when I told you about it before?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The other day, Turbo shared her super-rare crab gummy with me, and Nature gave me her last scallop skirt.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Fuku-chan-senpai prayed for my victory with some tokoroten noodles, and my little kid friends and everyone in the shopping district gave me so much warm support!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You always tell me how energetic I am, Trainer, but that's only because I get so much love and cheer from everyone—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: In other words, I wanted to do the same for you! So you can feel totally energized!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as she said, I had witnessed it firsthand. How she was adored, loved, and cheered on by the kids and the neighborhood locals alike.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mun-mun-muuun...!! Gathering up all the warm-and-fuzzies!!
Energy, energy, maximum super-energyyyy~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to her, I took another look at the assortment before me.
It was a completely random mishmash, but what truly mattered was the heartfelt effort she put into gathering it all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It carried the very same warmth she had received from everyone around her.
choice_data_list: I received your sources of energy. Loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really? Did you get your energy back...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pheeew, thank goodness~ What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but, but—did you like the lineup?
Is there anything else you'd like? If so, I can dash right over and grab it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I assured her I was fine, but Matikanetannhauser kept fluttering around restlessly for a while. Just watching her made me feel truly re-energized.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm! Look at this crowd! Listen to all the bustling noise!
Now this really feels like a festival~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We arrived at the summer festival grounds. Perhaps buoyed by the festive atmosphere, Matikanetannhauser seemed to be having a blast.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mambo, mambo-ooh~! Festival mambo-oooh♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~ It's a chant my dad taught me!
Wanna try doing it together, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wasshoi mambo, festival mambo-oooh♪
Splish-splash, sway-sway, festival mambo-ooooh♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she was just as deeply loved by her family as she was by everyone around her.
With her by my side, I knew we would continue to share many wonderful days ahead.
